summary:
VYBE Master Product Upgrade Implementation Plan covering:
- Preservation of package identity, Supabase backend, database, and APK compatibility.
- New distinctive VYBE design system with deep dark purple/violet tones and seamless instant 3-way theme switching (Dark/Light/System) across all screens.
- Original Home Screen experience featuring interactive cards for VYBE Unload, Time Capsule, Crossed Paths, Nearby, Explore Zone, VYBE Matches, Communities, and Trending.
- Bottom navigation realignment: Home, Explore, Vybe (Reels), Inbox, Profile.
- Complete Inbox & Messaging fix: solving the Supabase RPC parameter mismatch (p_peer_id), non-dropping conversation fallbacks, and sub-50ms push delivery.
- Real live interaction rooms in VYBE Unload, Time Capsules with recipient locking and scheduled triggers, and privacy-first Crossed Paths location telemetry.
- Feed modernization with mood tags and private appreciation, verified badge management system, and comprehensive central Admin Portal overhaul.
